item.title: 21 Aug — Short clocks, sharp teeth
item.description:
Private — Head of Products
Tonight is a concept issue. Our probes across P0 geos (UK/Gibraltar, Tanzania/East Africa, UAE/MENA, Brazil/LATAM, India/SEA) and Tier‑1/crypto‑native venues surfaced no material moves inside the window you gave us (Aug 20–21, local +04).
Mechanism note — Short clocks, sharp teeth - Problem: In 5–30 minute “up/down” crypto books, makers are picked off by faster takers…
